output.postmortem: Technical Postmortem for inc-1788158597289. Timeline: 06:43:17Z - Incident started, 50% impression gap detected on Roku devices. 06:44:00Z - Automated diagnostics confirmed F07 (Beacon Failure) and ruled out other causes. 06:45:00Z - Auto-remediation runbook 'rb-beacon-fallback' was executed. 06:46:00Z - Impression gap returned to 0, incident resolved. Root Cause: Impression beacons from Roku devices were not being collected. Upstream ad delivery systems operated normally. The issue was isolated to the beacon collection stage for the Roku device class. Supporting Evidence: Key metrics confirmed the diagnosis: impression_gap_affected=0.5, impression_gap_others=0, ads_pod_seconds_filled=0.875, ads_nofill_rate=0, cdn_5xx=0. Action Taken: The system automatically reconfigured the SSAI service to use server-side beaconing for the 'roku' device class via a POST to /admin/beacon-mode. Verification: The impression gap for Roku devices returned to 0 post-remediation, confirmed by the residualGap metric being 0.
